The call was directionally wrong on a relative basis: -4.0% alpha vs the HSI (raw -3.0% against a rising index) means an underweight beat the Hold, and the 6.0 target was never approached. The bearish half of the thesis held — negative risk/reward at 5.71, the 5.89–5.97 supply zone, and the downtrending 200SMA correctly flagged the drift into the 5.49–5.57 band without breaching the 5.25 stop — while the "strong cash flow justifies no sell" half cost 4 points of relative performance. Lesson: when trend structure (200SMA down, bearish MACD) and short-term risk/reward are both negative, that evidence supports trimming/underweighting, not just refusing to add — reserve full-position Hold for setups where the benchmark backdrop is also weak.

The bearish fundamental case (halved operating profit, negative FCF, inventory build) failed to translate into price weakness, while the exact buffers the thesis cited as reasons to avoid Sell—HK$12.3bn of buybacks, net cash, and 0.716 beta—drove the rebound; worse, the decision underweighted at 25.24 before its own stated trigger (daily close below 24.82–24.92) fired, repeating the exact error flagged in the prior review ("破位须以日收盘确认为准"). Lesson: for names already down ~55% with net cash and active buyback support, treat further downside as unconfirmed until the close-based trigger executes—no position action on proximity to support—and size bearish conviction to the confirmed evidence, not the thesis narrative.
